plan.summary:
Changes the default model from `model-6-1` to `model-6-2`.

- `DEFAULT_MODEL` in `src/models.ts` now points to `model-6-2`.
- Two tests update their hard-coded model name to match.
plan.riskRationale: One constant changes. Two tests change only their expected strings. The tests pass an explicit model, so they do not read DEFAULT_MODEL.
plan.storyArc: The default model constant is bumped. The two tests then use the new model name in their inputs and expectations.

topics.title: Default model changes to model-6-2
topics.narrativeBrief: What is the new default model, and how do the tests follow? Verify whether the tests read DEFAULT_MODEL or pass the model name explicitly. The excerpts show explicit values.
